records.text: Lori Frantzve's divorce filing says Lori and Kent Frantzve married on November 20, 1995, in Marblehead, Massachusetts.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: One of the facts is that Kent (Kenneth Frantzve) and Lori (Lori Frantzve) were married on November 20th, 1995 in Marblehead, Massachusetts.

records.text: The Frantzves' divorce decree again lists a November 20, 1995 marriage date, but someone later edited it by hand to 1985.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Once again, the marriage date is listed, ... the initial marriage date between Kent (Kenneth Frantzve) and Lori (Lori Frantzve) as November 20th, 1995 in Marblehead, Massachusetts. ... you can see that somebody just went in and tried to edit that date by hand afterward, ... adjusting the wedding date down this time to 1985,

verification.notes: The displayed paperwork is reported to contain a handwritten 1985 date that conflicts with the typed 1995 filing chronology. That supports the discrepancy, but not the stronger inference that someone later edited the document; timing and authorship of the handwriting are unestablished.

records.text: Across two divorce documents there are four plausible marriage dates for Kent and Lori Frantzve, and Candace Owens could not find a record of their alleged Marblehead marriage under any of the dates.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Four different dates to the alleged wedding between Lori (Lori Frantzve) and Kent (Kent Frantzve). An unnotarized child care agreement plus a different date for Erika (Erika Kirk)'s birthday than the one initially listed in the Cincinnati News, November 22nd, across four sets of documents. ... They were not able to pull up any marriage documents. That doesn't mean they don't exist.

So what do we discern from this? We are at four different plausible marriage dates between Kent and Lori Frantzve across two documents. ... I should also add that I could not find a single trace of their alleged. ... alleged marriage in Marblehead, Massachusetts doesn't mean that it doesn't exist, but I couldn't find it across any dates.

verification.notes: The claim combines several conflicting dates from privately displayed records and the speaker's report that she could not locate a marriage record. No authoritative marriage index or complete court docket was accessible to establish all four dates or prove absence of a record.

records.text: Deeds obtained by a researcher listed Lori and Kent Frantzve as a couple from North Kingstown, Rhode Island, although Candace Owens said she could find no trace that they lived there
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But they were able to pull up some deeds where Lori (Lori Frantzve) and Kent (Kent Frantzve) had signed the deeds over and when they had first received the deed to their home in Marblehead, Massachusetts. ... And there's a little interesting tidbit here where Lori (Lori Frantzve) and Kent (Kent Frantzve) are listing as having been a couple from Rhode Island, from North Kingstown. ... Apparently they lived there, except I can't find a trace of Lori (Lori Frantzve) and Kent (Kent Frantzve) having lived in Rhode Island.

verification.notes: The transcript relies on deeds and an asserted absence of a Rhode Island residence trace. Current searches did not locate the cited deeds or a comprehensive residence record, so neither the deed wording nor the negative-location inference can be independently resolved.
